description: Close the named app, or close the active session app when app is omitted. When this session's open booted a local simulator or emulator, close stops it too, leaving the device as the session found it; a device that was already running keeps running. For an Apple simulator, the proof that open booted it is that open's own boot step performed the boot; when something else booted it first, plain close leaves the simulator running and warns with boot-owner-unverified. When the emulator process its own open launched is gone or cannot be verified, plain close leaves the emulator running and warns. Pass shutdown to explicitly stop a local simulator or emulator regardless of boot ownership. A daemon whose policy denies device-shutdown skips the implicit stop on plain close, which succeeds with a warning that the local device stays running. Explicit close with shutdown fails with UNAUTHORIZED and details.reason DAEMON_POLICY_DENIED. Android ADB close fails with android-app-close-timeout if the app stays foreground past 2s, a killed process does not exit within 10s, or a new process runs past 2s; a relaunching open accepts that new process. For foreground timeouts, JSON details include foregroundObservations and initialProcessCount; the android_close_foreground_fence request diagnostic retains the last five probe results and timings, including when a probe throws. It fails with android-process-probe-unavailable when adb pidof cannot list the app processes; if that happens before the force-stop, the app keeps running. If close cannot confirm its cleanup on a session that holds a device claim, the session and its claim stay. A repeated close retries cleanup with the same options, except that save-script must be omitted after publication. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

force.description: Overwrite an existing --save-script target instead of refusing (alias: --overwrite).

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

shutdown.description: Shutdown the session/device where supported, even one this session did not boot.

name: close
title: Close an app or end the session
